item.title: GAA on TV: Allianz Hurling League comes into focus this weekend with five games to watch live
item.description: The Allianz Hurling League takes centre stage this weekend with five games available for fans to watch live.

item.title: Waterford v Tipperary postponed due to bereavement
item.description: Tomorrow afternoon's Allianz Hurling League Division 1A clash between Waterford and Tipperary has been postponed due to a bereavement.

item.title: St Kieran's Kilkenny set-up Croke Cup final date with Pres College Athenry
item.description: St Kieran's Kilkenny will play Galway's Pres College Athenry in the All-Ireland Schools SAHC final at Croke Park on St Patrick's Day after both sides came through their respective semi-finals this afternoon.

item.title: Camogie round-up: Galway and Waterford claim wins while Cork bounce back against Kilkenny
item.description: Waterford are out in front by themselves after winning in Antrim but just one result separates the other five in what is turning out to be an incredibly tight Division 1A race in the Centra National Camogie League, with no winless teams after three rounds of games in the top tier.

item.title: Draws made for group stages of 2026 TG4 All-Ireland Championships
item.description: The draws have been made for the group stages of the 2026 TG4 All-Ireland Championships.

item.title: Tyrone thump relegated Armagh while Sligo secure promotion back to Division 3
item.description: Tyrone recorded their third win in Division 3 of the Allianz Hurling League this afternoon by seeing off already relegated Armagh on a 3-22 to 0-11 scoreline in Garvaghey.

item.title: Dublin demolish Down for third win in Division 1B
item.description: Dublin hit Down for six goals at Parnell Park this evening on their way to recording a third win in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Tribesmen prove too strong for Cats in Salthill
item.description: Cathal Mannion and Aaron Niland starred as Galway inflicted Kilkenny with their third defeat of the Allianz Hurling League Division 1A campaign this evening.

item.title: Watch: Limerick find goal-scoring touch to inflict Cork's first league defeat
item.description: Limerick struck three well-timed goals to deal Cork their first defeat of this year's Allianz Hurling League campaign.
